name: git-for-dsh
description: Allowlisted git execution for DeepSeek Harness: a model-facing git tool that runs outside the file sandbox, with a settings page where the user ticks which git subcommands are permitted and which credential paths the model must not read
_comment: No version appears in any document or UI: npm needs this field to publish and the registry needs it to resolve a range, but the code never reads it. src/ is the source of truth — lib/ is committed so that installing from git needs no build step (pnpm gates build scripts behind a per-commit allowBuilds key).
_peers: Every peer here is provided by the harness and is NOT on the public registry: these packages ship nested inside @deepseek-ai/dsh, so npm cannot resolve them. They are therefore all optional, which is what stops the 'issues with peer dependencies found' warning; dsh's loader resolves them at runtime.
